text:
mira: Quick sync — AWS/GCP/Azure storefront activation kickoff. Need to align IAM roles, trial SKU packaging, and legal signoff. Who's owning tenant provisioning?

alex: I can take tenant provisioning for AWS + Azure. Need the pub account IDs.

mira: thx alex — @sam can you handle GCP? Also need legal checklist from @emily.

sam: I can do GCP. ETA EOD tomorrow for initial IAM role configs.

alex: For AWS we'll create a cross-account role with trust policy — snippet:
```
RoleName: RedwoodMarketplacePubRole
Trust: {"AWS": ["arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root"]}
Permissions: ["sts:AssumeRole", "s3:GetObject"]
```

alex: We'll also need the AMI/asset S3 bucket details from the packaging team.

emily: Legal: draft T&Cs + privacy addendum need 2 business days. Also confirm data residency regions for EU.

mira: EU residency confirmed for this tenant set (europe-west1, eu-west-1). Add to legal note.

kyle: Packaging: can produce trial SKU and hero tile assets by Thu. Need final copy and logo versions.

mira: Great. Action items:
- alex: AWS IAM role + cross-account setup (aws-account IDs needed)
- sam: GCP IAM + service account + roles
- kyle: packaging assets + SKU config
- emily: legal checklist + residency confirmation
I'll assemble a doc — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MP-XXXX (will update with final link)

sam: Quick Q: for GCP do we use org-level binding or project-level SA? leaning project-level to avoid org perms.

mira: project-level ok. Log tickets if org perms required.

alex: Also recommending an expiration tag on roles for 90 days for staging.

emily: Noted. I'll include compliance note re: data flow and logs.

mira: Perfect — let's reconvene Fri 10am PT. :calendar:

deploy-bot: Reminder — marketplace checklist task created: #MP-4321
